# Jumeirah Asora Bay

> Jumeirah Asora Bay is a hotel and branded residential development on the La Mer South peninsula in Dubai. Meraas markets 29 residences, while Dubai Holding describes a hotel with 103 rooms and suites and 20 villas. These counts cover distinct components of the development.

## Project Overview

- Location: La Mer South, Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
